findings.message: The docstring leaves γ free, while the elaborated theorem asks whether there exists one uniform γ with 1 < γ < 2 that works for every admissible α and β. The missing quantifier, bounds, and uniformity make the documented problem materially ambiguous.
findings.suggestion: Rewrite the docstring to say: “Does there exist a real γ with 1 < γ < 2 such that, for every α, β > 0 with α/β irrational, this multiset is complete?”
